name: Disinformation
text: Sway 8 toward Discord.

name: Backdoor Research
text: 4 adversary research cubes onto each open megaproject.

name: Rolling Blackouts
text: Until the end of next round, cities make no energy.

name: Botnet Swarm
text: Each country, twice: a botnet spreads to its lowest-numbered city, research station or factory next to one of its botnets (no botnet there: its lowest-numbered research station).

name: False Flag
text: Each country: an extra tier-2 threat, any tag.

name: Night Raid
text: Each country: 1 Agent onto each of two different hexes holding a player node (those holding the most Agents first; ties: lowest-numbered). 2 Agents on your node's hex destroy your node in the next Corrupt beat.

name: Containment Breach
text: Each player pays 1 antimatter or discards 3 cards.

name: Crackdown
text: Each country: every player Ambassador on its hex holding the most (ties: lowest-numbered) goes back to its owner's supply.

name: Lab Purge
text: Each open megaproject loses 4 player research cubes, from the player with the most on it first.

name: Asset Seizure
text: Each country: its neutral factory with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) is corrupted; with none neutral, its player-owned factory picked the same way turns neutral.

name: Botnet Conscripts
text: Each country: its lowest-numbered botnet becomes 3 Troops on its hex.

name: Purge Lists
text: Each player loses 1 Ambassador (from their supply, else one of theirs on the board).

name: Dirty Bomb
text: Each country: 1 Fallout lands next to each of its two lowest-numbered corrupted cities.

name: Lab Seizure
text: Corrupt: research stations.

name: Slander Campaign
text: Pull 4 Sway back off the Unity track.

name: Coastal Raids
text: Rally 3, each country: coastal cities.

name: Plant Seizure
text: Corrupt: factories.

name: Sabotage Teams
text: Each country: the hardened facility with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) loses its hardening. Until the end of next round, players make no energy from their nodes in upkeep.

name: Mob Rule
text: Rally 3, each country: cities. Sway 3 toward Discord.

name: Data Heist
text: Each player removes 3 tokens from their cards (their choice of cards). Each player pays 8 credits or discards 2 cards.

name: Hostile Takeover
text: Rally 3, each country: factories. Corrupt: factories.

name: Station Coup
text: Each country: its neutral research station with the most Agents on or next to it (ties: lowest-numbered) is corrupted; with none neutral, its player-owned station picked the same way turns neutral. Then each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted research station.

name: War Plants
text: Each country: the adversary builds a factory on its free industrial zone next to an Agent, else its lowest-numbered (none free: 2 Agents on one of its factories). Every adversary factory makes 2 Troops on its hex (a player Ambassador on it stops them).

name: Recruitment Drive
text: Income: +1 Agent a country a round. Rally 2, each country: cities.

name: Propaganda Network
text: Income: +1 compute a country a round. Sway 6 toward Discord.

name: Infiltration Drive
text: Rally 3, each country: cities. Corrupt: cities (1 fewer). Then each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city.

name: Accelerated Timetable
text: Discard the top face-down card of the adversary's event deck, if any: the round cap comes a round sooner. Each country: an extra tier-2 threat, any tag.

name: Grand Offensive
text: Each country rallies its Agent income now, to this round's Rally. Corrupt: cities. Corrupt: factories.
